resources.string: Toki translations and subtitle files: local data only

Use saved subtitle tracks/translations without remote fallback. Disconnected or unknown connectivity also denies remote requests. No local translation model is bundled: missing translations retain the original with a notice. This controls Toki’s translation transport and caption fetches only; it does not block TikTok’s own traffic or implement offline video export/comments. Re-enter the video after changing this option.
Local-only translation: no saved translation or ready local engine. The original text is retained; no remote request was started for this missing result.
Local-only captions: no saved subtitle file for this track. No remote file was fetched.
